question.en: Which animal can sleep for up to three years?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh tidur sehingga tiga tahun?

funFact.en: Some land snails can hibernate for years during dry conditions.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah siput darat boleh tidur panjang selama bertahun-tahun ketika keadaan kering.

question.en: Which animal has fingerprints almost identical to humans?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai cap jari hampir sama dengan manusia?

funFact.en: Koala fingerprints are so similar to humans they can confuse forensic investigators.
funFact.ms: Cap jari koala sangat mirip manusia sehingga boleh mengelirukan penyiasat forensik.

question.en: Which animal has three hearts?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai tiga jantung?

funFact.en: Two hearts pump blood to the gills while one pumps it to the body.
funFact.ms: Dua jantung mengepam darah ke insang dan satu ke seluruh badan.

question.en: Which bird can fly backwards?
question.ms: Burung manakah boleh terbang ke belakang?

funFact.en: Hummingbirds are the only birds capable of true backward flight.
funFact.ms: Hummingbird satu-satunya burung yang boleh terbang ke belakang.

question.en: Which animal can change color to blend into its surroundings?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh menukar warna untuk menyamar dengan persekitaran?

funFact.en: Chameleons change color using special skin cells called chromatophores.
funFact.ms: Chameleon menukar warna menggunakan sel kulit khas dipanggil kromatofor.

question.en: Which animal can regrow an entire arm if it loses one?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh menumbuhkan semula lengan jika hilang?

funFact.en: Starfish can regenerate limbs and sometimes an entire body.
funFact.ms: Bintang laut boleh menumbuhkan semula anggota badan malah seluruh badan.

question.en: Which animal has the longest migration of any mammal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai migrasi paling jauh antara mamalia?

funFact.en: Gray whales migrate up to 20,000 km each year.
funFact.ms: Paus kelabu berhijrah sehingga 20,000 km setiap tahun.

question.en: Which insect is strong enough to carry many times its body weight?
question.ms: Serangga manakah cukup kuat untuk membawa berat berkali ganda daripada badannya?

funFact.en: Ants can carry up to 50 times their own body weight.
funFact.ms: Semut boleh membawa sehingga 50 kali berat badannya.

question.en: Which fish can generate electricity?
question.ms: Ikan manakah boleh menghasilkan elektrik?

funFact.en: Electric eels can generate shocks of up to 600 volts.
funFact.ms: Belut elektrik boleh menghasilkan kejutan sehingga 600 volt.

question.en: Which animal has the longest neck?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai leher paling panjang?

funFact.en: A giraffe's neck can be about 2 meters long.
funFact.ms: Leher zirafah boleh sepanjang kira-kira 2 meter.

question.en: Which animal has the largest eyes of any land animal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai mata terbesar antara haiwan darat?

funFact.en: Ostrich eyes are bigger than their brains.
funFact.ms: Mata burung unta lebih besar daripada otaknya.

question.en: Which animal can run the fastest on land?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh berlari paling laju di darat?

funFact.en: Cheetahs can reach speeds up to 100 km/h.
funFact.ms: Cheetah boleh mencapai kelajuan sehingga 100 km/j.

question.en: Which animal can survive the longest without drinking water?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup paling lama tanpa minum air?

funFact.en: Kangaroo rats get almost all their water from the seeds they eat.
funFact.ms: Tikus kangaroo mendapat hampir semua air daripada biji yang dimakan.

question.en: Which animal can live both in water and on land?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup di air dan di darat?

funFact.en: Frogs are amphibians and spend parts of their lives in water and on land.
funFact.ms: Katak ialah amfibia dan hidup sebahagian masa di air dan darat.

question.en: Which animal has the thickest fur of any mammal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai bulu paling tebal antara mamalia?

funFact.en: Sea otters have up to 1 million hairs per square inch.
funFact.ms: Memerang laut mempunyai sehingga 1 juta helai bulu setiap inci persegi.

question.en: Which animal has the longest lifespan of any mammal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai jangka hayat paling panjang antara mamalia?

funFact.en: Bowhead whales can live for more than 200 years.
funFact.ms: Paus Bowhead boleh hidup lebih 200 tahun.

question.en: Which bird is the largest living bird?
question.ms: Burung manakah yang terbesar hidup hari ini?

funFact.en: Ostriches can grow over 2.7 meters tall.
funFact.ms: Burung unta boleh membesar lebih 2.7 meter tinggi.

question.en: Which animal has the strongest bite force of any living animal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai daya gigitan paling kuat antara haiwan hidup?

funFact.en: Saltwater crocodiles have the strongest bite recorded in animals.
funFact.ms: Buaya air masin mempunyai gigitan paling kuat pernah direkodkan.

question.en: Which animal is known for playing dead to escape predators?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah terkenal berpura-pura mati untuk lari dari pemangsa?

funFact.en: Opossums can remain motionless and appear dead when threatened.
funFact.ms: Opossum boleh tidak bergerak dan kelihatan mati apabila terancam.

question.en: Which plant closes its leaves when touched?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah menutup daunnya apabila disentuh?

funFact.en: Mimosa pudica quickly folds its leaves as a defense mechanism.
funFact.ms: Mimosa pudica melipat daunnya dengan cepat sebagai mekanisme pertahanan.

question.en: Which animal can survive being frozen and thawed back to life?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup semula selepas dibekukan dan dicairkan?

funFact.en: Wood frogs can survive winter with ice forming inside their bodies.
funFact.ms: Katak kayu boleh hidup sepanjang musim sejuk walaupun ais terbentuk dalam badannya.

question.en: Which marine animal is considered biologically immortal because it can revert to its juvenile form?
question.ms: Haiwan laut manakah dianggap hampir abadi kerana boleh kembali ke bentuk muda?

funFact.en: This jellyfish can revert to its polyp stage and start its life cycle again.
funFact.ms: Obor-obor ini boleh kembali ke tahap polip dan memulakan semula kitaran hidupnya.

question.en: Which animal has the largest brain relative to body size among invertebrates?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai otak terbesar berbanding saiz badan antara invertebrata?

funFact.en: Octopuses are extremely intelligent and can solve puzzles.
funFact.ms: Gurita sangat pintar dan boleh menyelesaikan teka-teki.

question.en: Which bird has the largest wingspan of any living bird?
question.ms: Burung manakah mempunyai rentang sayap terbesar antara burung hidup?

funFact.en: The wandering albatross can have a wingspan over 3.5 meters.
funFact.ms: Albatros pengembara boleh mempunyai rentang sayap lebih 3.5 meter.

question.en: Which animal has the longest recorded tongue relative to body size?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai lidah terpanjang berbanding saiz badan?

funFact.en: A chameleon's tongue can be longer than its entire body.
funFact.ms: Lidah chameleon boleh lebih panjang daripada seluruh badannya.

question.en: Which mammal can glide through the air using a membrane between its limbs?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah boleh meluncur di udara menggunakan membran antara anggota badan?

funFact.en: The colugo can glide over 100 meters between trees.
funFact.ms: Kubung boleh meluncur lebih 100 meter antara pokok.

question.en: Which animal has blood that is naturally blue due to copper-based molecules?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai darah biru kerana molekul berasaskan tembaga?

funFact.en: Horseshoe crab blood is used in medical testing for bacteria.
funFact.ms: Darah ketam ladam digunakan dalam ujian perubatan untuk mengesan bakteria.

question.en: Which desert animal can survive losing up to 45% of its body water?
question.ms: Haiwan gurun manakah boleh hidup walaupun kehilangan 45% air badan?

funFact.en: Most mammals would die after losing just 15% of body water.
funFact.ms: Kebanyakan mamalia akan mati selepas kehilangan hanya 15% air badan.

question.en: Which insect has the fastest wingbeat among insects?
question.ms: Serangga manakah mempunyai kepakan sayap paling laju antara serangga?

funFact.en: Some midges can beat their wings over 1,000 times per second.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah midge boleh mengepakkan sayap lebih 1,000 kali sesaat.

question.en: Which animal has the ability to rotate its head up to 270 degrees?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh memusingkan kepala sehingga 270 darjah?

funFact.en: Owls have special blood vessels to prevent brain damage during head rotation.
funFact.ms: Burung hantu mempunyai saluran darah khas untuk melindungi otak semasa memusingkan kepala.

question.en: Which animal produces the loudest sound relative to its body size?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah menghasilkan bunyi paling kuat berbanding saiz badannya?

funFact.en: The pistol shrimp snaps its claw to create a shockwave.
funFact.ms: Udang pistol mengetuk penyepitnya untuk menghasilkan gelombang kejutan.

question.en: Which animal has square-shaped poop?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai najis berbentuk segi empat?

funFact.en: Wombats produce cube-shaped droppings that prevent them from rolling away.
funFact.ms: Wombat menghasilkan najis berbentuk kiub supaya tidak bergolek.

question.en: Which animal can detect electrical fields to locate prey?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh mengesan medan elektrik untuk mencari mangsa?

funFact.en: Sharks use special organs called ampullae of Lorenzini.
funFact.ms: Hiu menggunakan organ khas dipanggil ampullae of Lorenzini.

question.en: Which mammal is capable of true sustained flight?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah mampu terbang secara sebenar?

funFact.en: Bats are the only mammals capable of true powered flight.
funFact.ms: Kelawar ialah satu-satunya mamalia yang boleh terbang secara sebenar.

question.en: Which animal can survive extreme radiation levels far beyond humans?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup dalam radiasi jauh lebih tinggi daripada manusia?

funFact.en: Tardigrades can survive radiation, vacuum, and extreme temperatures.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade boleh hidup dalam radiasi, vakum, dan suhu ekstrem.

question.en: Which plant is famous for trapping insects using snap-like leaves?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah terkenal memerangkap serangga menggunakan daun seperti perangkap?

funFact.en: Venus flytraps snap shut in less than a second.
funFact.ms: Perangkap lalat Venus boleh menutup dalam masa kurang satu saat.

question.en: Which sea creature has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom?
question.ms: Makhluk laut manakah mempunyai mata terbesar dalam dunia haiwan?

funFact.en: Colossal squid eyes can be about 27 cm across.
funFact.ms: Mata sotong gergasi boleh mencapai kira-kira 27 cm.

question.en: Which bird is known for mimicking chainsaws, alarms, and other sounds?
question.ms: Burung manakah terkenal meniru bunyi gergaji, penggera, dan bunyi lain?

funFact.en: Lyrebirds can mimic dozens of natural and artificial sounds.
funFact.ms: Burung lyrebird boleh meniru puluhan bunyi semula jadi dan buatan.

question.en: Which animal can stretch its stomach to eat prey much larger than itself?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh mengembangkan perut untuk makan mangsa lebih besar daripadanya?

funFact.en: Snakes have flexible jaws that allow them to swallow large prey.
funFact.ms: Ular mempunyai rahang fleksibel untuk menelan mangsa besar.

question.en: Which fish can climb waterfalls using a suction-like mouth?
question.ms: Ikan manakah boleh memanjat air terjun menggunakan mulut seperti penyedut?

funFact.en: Some Hawaiian gobies climb waterfalls to reach safe upstream habitats.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah goby Hawaii memanjat air terjun untuk sampai ke habitat selamat di hulu.
